quotes.text: My brother-in-law was in town and we wanted to do something fun with him. He’d never been to LI, and we thought the best way to see it would be a cruise on the water. We rented a boat here after being referred by a friend, and we had a blast out there! It was just as exciting for us to get a different perspective on the island as it was for him. We don’t fish, but these boats would be perfect for that I imagine.

I reserved a 22.5 foot Scout online for 3 hours. We arrived and the boat was ready for us. Super clean and new motor looking. We were very happy with the young man who helped us and gave us guidelines of the waters there in Northport. Even though my husband is a seasoned boater. GPS system was perfect too. Very happy!
This is my second great experience on a Long Island boat rental and it was wonderful. Gorgeous weather, courteous crew and lovely views. My husband and I can’t wait to come back again soon!
I have rented three times so far. The boats are always in excellent condition, and the staff could not be more friendly or more helpful. Get out on the water!
